description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Language class, which manages localizable messages, error names, and language-specific formatting for HTML Purifier.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Language
classes.description: Represents a language and defines localizable string formatting and messages for HTML Purifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the language object with configuration and context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language data from the factory cache if not already loaded.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a localized message by key.

methods.name: getErrorName
methods.description: Retrieves a localized error name by error code.

methods.name: listify
methods.description: Converts an array into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a localized message with parameters, handling objects and arrays.
